records.source: Brr... It's cold! I wanna get back under the covers...
records.translation: 嘶……好冷！我想回被窩裡……

records.source: Elliott's drinking too much cider again...$7#$e#I'll come meet you at the table when I can find an exit... I'm starving!
records.translation: 艾利歐特又喝了太多蘋果酒……$7#$e#等我找到出口就去餐桌旁找你……我快餓死了！

records.source: I'm thankful to have a loving family and you in my life...$0
records.translation: 我很感恩生命中有充滿愛的家人，還有你……$0

records.source: I hope everyone likes my powdermelon crisp...$h
records.translation: 希望大家都喜歡我做的粉瓜酥……$h

records.source: When I count all the good things in my life, I feel like I've been blessed by the Winter Star.
records.translation: 細數生命中所有美好的事物時，我覺得自己受到了冬日星的祝福。

records.source: When Haley and I were kids, we always used to decorate cookies at this festival.#$b#We should do it sometime! You can't let good traditions die out.$h
records.translation: 我和海莉小時候總會在這個節日裝飾餅乾。#$b#我們改天也該試試！不能讓美好的傳統消失。$h

records.source: Hey... don't worry, you don't need to get me anything.$h#$e#I'm just happy to wake up next to you every morning... what else could a guy ask for?$l
records.translation: 嘿……別擔心，你不必送我任何東西。$h#$e#每個早晨能在你身旁醒來，我就很幸福了……一個男人還能奢求什麼？$l

records.source: It's kinda fun watching everyone unwrap their presents... seeing their reactions.$h#$e#Oh yeah, I got you something. I'll uhh... show you when we get back to the farmhouse!$10
records.translation: 看大家拆禮物、觀察他們的反應，還挺有趣的。$h#$e#喔，對了，我也替你準備了東西。等我們回到農舍，我再……展示給你看！$10

records.source: Let me know if you get cold. I'll lend you my jacket.$0
records.translation: 如果覺得冷就告訴我。我會把外套借給你。$0

records.source: There's a lot I'm thankful for, like my clinic, the good health of my patients...#$b#But ultimately, I'm most thankful for the life we're building together...$l
records.translation: 我有許多值得感恩的事，比如我的診所、病人們的健康……#$b#但歸根究柢，我最感恩的是我們正在共同建立的生活……$l

records.source: My dear, I require nothing at all on this day... you are already the greatest gift a man could hope for.$h
records.translation: 親愛的，今天我什麼都不需要……你已是男人所能期望的最美好禮物。$h

records.source: What am I thankful for?#$b#....uh...$3#$b#I'm thankful... that you pulled me out of the gutter. And showed me that life is worth living.$6
records.translation: 我感恩的是什麼？#$b#……呃……$3#$b#我很感恩……你把我從泥淖中拉了出來，讓我明白人生值得活下去。$6

records.source: I wonder which present is mine...$0#$e#I hope it's the big box!$h
records.translation: 不知道哪份禮物是我的……$0#$e#希望是那個大盒子！$h

records.source: Welp... Husband got me a new power saw this year...$6#$b#He must've forgotten that he got me the same thing two years ago!$6
records.translation: 嗯……丈夫今年送了我一把新的電鋸……$6#$b#他肯定忘了兩年前也送過我同樣的東西！$6

records.source: Hmm... this green jelly has a minty flavor to it.$3#$b#I wonder how mint became associated with the Feast Of The Winter Star? Does mint even grow in Winter?$3
records.translation: 嗯……這個綠色果凍帶有薄荷味。$3#$b#不知道薄荷怎麼會和冬日星盛宴產生關聯？薄荷冬天真的會生長嗎？$3

records.source: It's pretty chilly today. Good thing everyone here is bundled up.$0
records.translation: 今天相當寒冷。幸好這裡每個人都穿得很暖。$0

records.source: One benefit of the cold weather is that I can put frozen pizzas under the tree.#$e#Someone's in for a real treat...$h
records.translation: 寒冷天氣的一個好處，就是我能把冷凍披薩放在樹下。#$e#有人要大飽口福了……$h

records.source: I guess it's nice the whole family is together for once.$7
records.translation: 我想，一家人難得齊聚一堂也挺好的。$7

records.source: Need any last minute gifts? I've got you covered! Take a look at my wares.$0
records.translation: 需要臨時補買禮物嗎？交給我就對了！看看我的商品。$0

records.source: Isn't the tree gorgeous?$h#$b#I spent all morning decorating it with Marnie and Jodi. It's a fun tradition!
records.translation: 這棵樹不是很華麗嗎？$h#$b#我整個早上都在和瑪妮、喬迪一起裝飾。這項傳統很有趣！

records.source: The mayor personally invited me to his table. I couldn't turn that down!
records.translation: 鎮長親自邀請我加入他的餐桌。我沒辦法拒絕！

records.source: I'm pretty sure there's a gridball-shaped present with my name on it underneath the spirit tree.$1
records.translation: 我很確定精靈樹下有一份寫著我名字的格球形禮物。$1

records.source: I already spend all day with the family, anyway. Why do we need a big hubbub out in the cold?$0
records.translation: 反正我整天都和家人在一起。為什麼還要在寒風裡大張旗鼓地鬧一場？$0

records.source: You are more than welcome to join us at our table, dear.$0
records.translation: 親愛的，非常歡迎你來加入我們的餐桌。$0

records.source: Happy Feast Of The Winter Star, @.$h#$e#This is a time to unwind, enjoy good company, and express gratitude for all that we have.$0
records.translation: 冬日星盛宴快樂，@。$h#$e#這是放鬆身心、享受良伴，並為我們擁有的一切表達感激的時刻。$0

records.source: I could use some new blacksmithing tools. Mine have gotten a little rusty over the years.$0
records.translation: 我需要一些新的鍛造工具。這些年來，我的工具已經有點生鏽了。$0

records.source: Look! It's the 'Winter Star'!%noturn$6#$e#Oh, my mistake. It's just a decoration!$h
records.translation: 看！是「冬日星」！%noturn$6#$e#喔，我看錯了。那只是裝飾！$h

records.source: $y 'Hello, @. What kind of gift are you hoping to receive this year?_An iridium milk pail_Oh? I've never heard of such a thing. It sounds expensive._An interesting book_Yes, a book can make a very nice gift!$h_A lump of coal_...I can't tell if you're joking, but that could be a useful gift!$h'
records.translation: $y '你好，@。你今年希望收到什麼樣的禮物？_一個銥製擠奶桶_喔？我從沒聽過那種東西。聽起來很昂貴。_一本有趣的書_是啊，書可以成為很棒的禮物！$h_一塊煤炭_……我不知道你是不是在開玩笑，但那可能是份實用的禮物！$h'

records.source: Mulled wine is the only thing keepin' me warm in this freezing weather!$h
records.translation: 在這種冰冷天氣裡，只有熱紅酒能讓我暖和！$h

records.source: It's so pretty... I wish our town could always look like this!$0
records.translation: 真漂亮……希望我們的小鎮永遠都能是這副模樣！$0

records.source: This spot is for the overflow presents. There's just too many to count this year!$0
records.translation: 這裡是用來放那些堆不下的禮物。今年的禮物多到數不清！$0

records.source: Seeing my little boy happy and healthy is what I'm thankful for.$h
records.translation: 我最感恩的，就是看到小兒子健康快樂。$h

records.source: Who gifts someone a Joja basket?...$2
records.translation: 誰會送人一個 Joja 禮籃啊？……$2

records.source: Sometimes I dread going to parties, but afterwards I'm always glad I went!
records.translation: 有時候我很怕參加聚會，但事後總會慶幸自己去了！

records.source: Happy Feasting, @!$1
records.translation: 祝你盛宴愉快，@！$1

records.source: *urp*$8#$b#Ahh... excuse me. Where are my manners? This spiced cider has quite a potent fizz to it.$4
records.translation: *打嗝*$8#$b#啊……請原諒。我的禮貌去哪了？這杯香料蘋果酒的氣泡相當強勁。$4

records.source: Eat! Eat, while it's still fresh and hot.$0#$e#I could go on and on about my new method of making candy canes... but I'll spare you the details this year!$1
records.translation: 吃吧！趁食物還新鮮熱乎時多吃點。$0#$e#我可以滔滔不絕地講解製作拐杖糖的新方法……但今年就放過你，不說那些細節了！$1

records.source: I'm a simple man, @... I'm thankful for a solid roof over me head, and a hot can o' beans in the mornin'!$h
records.translation: 我是個簡單的人，@……我很感恩頭頂有堅固的屋頂，早晨還有一罐熱豆子！$h

records.source: Ah, the mysterious Winter Star. One of the reasons I chose this valley as the location for my... research.
records.translation: 啊，神祕的冬日星。它是我選擇這座山谷作為……研究地點的原因之一。

records.source: Have you tried the pecan pie? It's my favorite.$0
records.translation: 你吃過山核桃派了嗎？那是我的最愛。$0

records.source: Is it time to open presents yet?$0
records.translation: 可以拆禮物了嗎？$0

records.source: I got the toy dinosaur I wanted! See!?$1#$e#It's called um... a ste-...stego-...stegosonaurus! ...I think.$0
records.translation: 我拿到自己想要的玩具恐龍了！看吧！？$1#$e#牠叫做，呃……劍……劍龍……劍龍龍！……大概吧。$0

records.source: Hmm? Oh, hello.$0#$e#Don't pay any mind to me. Go enjoy yourself.
records.translation: 嗯？喔，你好。$0#$e#別在意我。去好好玩吧。

records.source: I don't know what most of this stuff is... but it tastes good!$0
records.translation: 這些東西大多我都不認識……但很好吃！$0
